<thought>Using the dominant ESI‑MS peak at m/z ≈ 183.045 as the protonated ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is about 182.038 Da. The isotopic pattern (~10 % M+1) indicates roughly ten carbon atoms. The formula C₉H₁₀O₄ has 9 carbons (≈9 % M+1) and a calculated neutral monoisotopic mass of 182.0579 Da, which is the closest reasonable match among simple C/H/O formulas. No other common heteroatoms improve the mass fit without violating the isotopic pattern. Therefore the most plausible molecular formula is C₉H₁₀O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O4</final_answer>
